name: Concrete
description: Slabs on grade (with mesh or rebar, vapor retarder and base), continuous footings, foundation walls with rebar and forms, pad footings, piers, columns, flatwork and curing. Assemblies only: set your own rates.
author: CadCraft

sources.title: International Residential Code, Section R506 Concrete Floors (on Ground): slab thickness, vapor retarder

International Residential Code, Section R403 Footings
ACI CODE-318, Building Code Requirements for Structural Concrete
ACI PRC-347, Guide to Formwork for Concrete
International Residential Code, Section R404 Foundation and Retaining Walls

assume: Concrete: 5% for over-excavation, uneven subgrade and spillage (a starting figure).
Base course: 4 in of clean graded gravel or sand (IRC R506.2.2).
Vapor retarder: 6-mil polyethylene (IRC R506.2.3), 10% for laps.
Welded wire reinforcement 6x6 W1.4xW1.4 sheets, 10% for laps.
Edge forms on the whole perimeter (lower the formula where the slab meets existing work).
items.note: Measure the slab area; the item depth is the slab thickness.
